B. Social Environment
Community Facilities:
a. Schools:
The four schools located within the Randolph Community are: Randolph School, Clark-Springs Elementary, Amelia-Marymont Elementary, and the West End Elementary. Randolph School is a Special Education facility for retarded children between the ages of 13 and 18 years. The 1972 enrollment of 398 pupils are bused from throughout the city as well as the Randolph Community. The Amelia-Maymont School, a recent combination of the Amelia and Maymont Elementary Schools, includes one division called the Oral School. The Oral School for deaf children, like the Randolph School, draws pupils from throughout the city. With these exceptions, the remaining school facilities are serving the children of the Randolph Community. Listed below are the schools by type, enrollment, and class structure:
